description: This Java class 'SwitchStateTableModel' extends DefaultTableModel and provides a custom table model for displaying switch states and their data as hex strings. It manages a map of switch state names to byte arrays, enabling retrieval of display data for a GUI table component.

classes.name: SwitchStateTableModel
classes.description: Custom table model for representing switch states and their data for a GUI table component.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table (2).

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of a specific column, either 'Switch State' or 'State Data'.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Returns the value at a specified row and column, either the switch state name or its data in hex format.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of switch state entries, or 0 if none.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in a given column.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that all cells are non-editable.

methods.name: setScalesList
methods.description: Sets the internal map of switch states to be displayed in the table.
